analysis.title: GS Crook - GS MORNING: 1) FX Trader Call Today, 2) Fed Speak & FOMC Minutes, 3) NBH Review, 4) NVDA Earnings and 5) CNY Fixing Trend Analysis 18 Nov 2026
key_insights: NVDA reported F3Q revenue of $115.8bn against consensus of $109bn and a company guide of about $108bn. Non-GAAP EPS was $2.68 against consensus of $2.47. The stock was up about 2% after hours.

NVDA Data Center revenue was $107.6bn, up 21% q/q, compared with about $89bn and +18% q/q the prior quarter. Gross margin was 74.9% against consensus and guide of about 74%, and about 75% last quarter.
NVDA guided F4Q revenue to $130bn against consensus of $125bn, with gross margin guided to 71-72% against consensus of 71.7%. GS trading says the guide includes zero China data centre compute.
NVDA raised its buyback authorization by $150bn, leaving $227.3bn remaining at the end of F3Q. Shareholder returns were $28bn in the October quarter against about $26bn the prior quarter.
The GS European trading desk says the one thing the market wanted was a hint that Jensen Huang could come back, and the company shut that down.

NY Fed President Williams said inflation is stubbornly high but the situation does not call for dramatic action, when asked about a 50bp hike in December. He described the firmer October core CPI as a continuation, not a broadening, of tariff and energy shock passthrough.
Vice Chair Jefferson said further hikes depend on trends in the data, which GS reads as a more gradual pace, while other FOMC participants have sounded more hawkish.

GS thinks the October FOMC meeting was consistent with a compromise to hike every other meeting. After last week's CPI, GS added a third 25bp hike in March 2027 to its forecast, following a second 25bp hike in December.
For the FOMC minutes, GS will look for the assumptions behind participants' economic outlooks and their views of the balance of risks.

The Hungarian central bank (MNB) held its policy rate at 5.50%, in line with GS and consensus. It expects inflation to rise in the coming months on fuel prices and policy measures such as higher tobacco excise duty and the retail tax, with the impact assessed in the December Inflation Report.

GS holds that Hungarian rates will be more dovish than market pricing implies. It cites the sharp fall in oil prices if maintained, lagged effects of past HUF strength, and a better-than-expected 2027 fiscal deficit target as room for the MNB to resume easing in coming months.

The USDCNY midpoint fixing was 6.7118, down 14 pips from the last fixing, a new year-to-date low. It passed through 24% of the Bloomberg survey implied daily change, and the spot-fixing gap is 456 pips.

GS reads the stronger fixing as a signal ahead of the APEC leaders summit and a Xi-Trump meeting, and notes it has historically seen stronger fixing into and after leader summits. GS keeps USDCNY NDF as a sell.

GS FX strats find the fixing has deviated at most about 0.4% from its year-to-date trend line, and 0.35% in the August-September episode. Replaying that episode from 15 Oct, their model puts the year-end fixing at 6.6511.

market_movers.rationale: F3Q results beat consensus on revenue, margin and EPS, and the F4Q revenue guide of $130bn is above the $125bn consensus. The stock was up about 2% after hours.

earnings_insights: NVDA F3Q reported 11/18: revenue $115.8bn vs consensus $109bn and company guide of about $108bn. Non-GAAP EPS $2.68 reported vs consensus $2.47.

NVDA F3Q reported: Data Center revenue $107.6bn, +21% q/q, vs about $89bn and +18% q/q in the prior quarter. Gross margin 74.9% vs consensus and guide of about 74%, and about 75% in the prior quarter.
NVDA F4Q guidance: revenue $130bn vs consensus $125bn. Gross margin guided to 71-72% vs consensus 71.7%. GS trading notes the guide has zero China data centre compute.

NVDA capital return: $28bn returned to shareholders in the October quarter vs about $26bn the prior quarter. The buyback authorization was increased by $150bn with no expiration, leaving $227.3bn remaining at end of F3Q.

A new year-to-date low in the fixing, 14 pips lower than the previous fixing, signalling a stronger yuan ahead of the leaders summit.
GS model output from replaying the August-September fixing episode starting 15 Oct.

trade_ideas.rationale: The fixing is trending stronger into and after leaders summits, and the fixing hit a new year-to-date low.
It expresses the grind lower in the fixing against a strong USD, with near flat carry and an attractive level.

risk_factors: Hungarian inflation expected to rise in coming months on fuel prices and tax measures such as the tobacco excise duty and retail tax.
The sharp fall in oil prices that supports the Hungarian easing view may not be maintained.
Other FOMC participants have sounded more hawkish than Jefferson, so December could bring a larger hike than the gradual pace implies.
USD strength driven by a hawkish Fed and AI concern pushes against the stronger CNY fixing.
charts_described: Line of best fit through the USDCNY fix year to date: in both directions the maximum deviation from the trend has been about 0.4%.
Zoom on the August-September episode, when the fixing reached a maximum deviation from trend of 0.35%.
Projection of the 0.35% maximum deviation forward to assess how far the fixing could diverge while staying consistent with the year-to-date pattern.
Replay of the Aug-Sep episode simulating the path from 15 Oct, with the model predicting a year-end fixing of 6.6511.
vol_and_positioning: GS expresses the near-term grind lower in the CNY fixing against a strong USD through a long USDCNH-USDCNY NDF basis. The 6m basis long is near flat carry and the level is attractive.
geopolitical: APEC leaders summit with a Xi-Trump meeting at lunch time on 19 Nov, which GS reads as the reason the CNY fixing has moved stronger this week.
Tariffs and an energy shock are cited by Williams as the source of the recent inflation passthrough.

tension_points.bull_case: Williams says the situation does not call for dramatic action and sees the CPI as a continuation of passthrough, not a broadening. Jefferson says hikes depend on trends in the data, which hints at a more gradual pace.
tension_points.bear_case: Other FOMC participants have sounded more hawkish. Williams said inflation is stubbornly high, and GS forecasts a second 25bp hike in December and a third in March 2027.

tension_points.bull_case: GS expects the MNB to resume easing in coming months on weak price developments, lagged HUF strength effects and a better-than-expected 2027 fiscal deficit target.
tension_points.bear_case: The MNB expects inflation to rise in the coming months on fuel prices and policy measures, and market pricing reflects inflation risks.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The sharp fall in oil prices not being maintained, which would remove the support GS cites against inflation concerns.
